name: tar
summary: Create, list or extract tar archives (c/x/t, -f, -z, -v, -C, -O, --strip-components, --exclude, --transform)

options.description: drop NUMBER leading path components when extracting
leave out members whose name, or any trailing part of it, matches the shell wildcard PATTERN (a directory's contents go with it); may be repeated
when creating, record NAME (or a numeric UID) as every member's owner
when creating, record NAME (or a numeric GID) as every member's group
store and list owners and groups as numbers only
rename members with sed-style s/REGEX/REPLACEMENT/FLAGS (flags g, i, x for extended regexes, or a number; several separated by ;) when creating or extracting; may be repeated
